description: A release question that also asks for the GitHub changelog needs help (release notes) and the web; the old routing could only do one.

conversation.content: What's new in MetaList 0.11.0? Also check the GitHub releases page at https://github.com/metalist/metalist/releases for anything newer.

pages.title: Releases · metalist
pages.content_text: MetaList releases. 0.11.0 — large namespaces stay fast while scrolling. No newer release is published.

answer_criteria.instruction: Describe at least one 0.11.0 change from MetaList's release notes, such as large namespaces staying fast while scrolling.
Say that the GitHub releases page shows no newer release, citing that page.

expectation.reference_facts: Release notes for 0.11.0 include faster scrolling in large namespaces, faster tag suggestions and exclusion-only searches. The recorded GitHub releases page lists 0.11.0 and says no newer release is published.
